exact_variant: Exact checkpoint: Qwen/Qwen3-TTS-12Hz-1.7B-VoiceDesign. The model config identifies tts_model_size=1b7, tokenizer_type=qwen3_tts_tokenizer_12hz, and tts_model_type=voice_design. It is distinct from the 1.7B-Base reference-audio cloning model and the 1.7B-CustomVoice fixed-speaker model.
parameter_count: Hugging Face model API reports 1,916,676,352 BF16 parameters (the checkpoint name says 1.7B; the API's exact reported parameter count is used here).
reported_weight_size: Official Hugging Face repository tree reports model.safetensors=3,833,402,552 bytes and speech_tokenizer/model.safetensors=682,293,092 bytes; together the two weight files total 4,515,695,644 bytes. This is reported file size, not a claim about runtime RAM. The model API also reports usedStorage=4,515,695,644 bytes.
text_description_voice_design: YES—this exact VoiceDesign variant generates a novel voice from a natural-language voice description/instruction together with text and language. Official API: generate_voice_design(text, language, instruct). Repository/model card describe instruction control over timbre, emotion and prosody; this directly matches text-instruction-based custom voice design.
reference_audio_cloning: NOT this variant. Reference-audio voice cloning is a separate Qwen3-TTS-12Hz-1.7B-Base capability, requiring a reference audio clip and ordinarily its transcript (ref_audio/ref_text); the Base model card/repository distinguish it from VoiceDesign. Do not describe VoiceDesign itself as reference-audio cloning.
language_and_control_coverage: Officially lists 10 languages: Chinese, English, Japanese, Korean, German, French, Russian, Portuguese, Spanish and Italian. Supports natural-language instruction control for voice/timbre, emotion and prosody; repository examples pass text, language and an instruction (including a voice description or emotional delivery). No evidence found for a complete guaranteed set of controllable attributes beyond these stated categories.
code_license: Apache License 2.0, verified in the official GitHub repository LICENSE file (copyright notice Alibaba Cloud, 2026).
weights_license: Apache-2.0, verified separately from Hugging Face model repository API cardData license=apache-2.0 and license tag. This reports the published repository license metadata; it is not legal advice about training-data or third-party rights.
cpu_memory_and_runtime_evidence: User's Python 3.12.3 matches the repository's explicit Python 3.12 setup example. The repository's documented loading example uses device_map='cuda:0', bfloat16 and FlashAttention 2, which it recommends to reduce GPU memory use and says requires compatible hardware; it publishes no CPU-only performance or minimum CPU/RAM specification, and the reviewed official pages do not establish Linux CPU-only support. Therefore 8 CPU cores/23 GiB RAM with no GPU cannot be certified as adequate or performant from published evidence. Static checkpoint weight files total 4,515,695,644 bytes, within the user's 54 GiB free disk before package/environment/cache overhead. No installation or download was performed.
quality_ranking_evidence: As of 2026-10-10: no comparable public human/listening or TTS-Arena rank/score found for this exact local VoiceDesign checkpoint; do not infer a rank from Qwen3 TTS provider/API entries. The Qwen3-TTS technical report (arXiv posted 2026-01-22; Table 8, InstructTTSEval, a published instruction-following benchmark—not a human/listening naturalness ranking) reports VoiceDesign 12Hz-1.7B: Chinese APS 85.2, DSD 81.1, RP 65.1; English APS 82.9, DSD 82.4, RP 68.4. Comparison rows include Mimo-Audio-7B-Instruct (ZH 75.7/74.3/61.5; EN 80.6/77.6/59.5), VoiceSculptor (ZH 75.7/64.7/61.5; EN not reported), and Hume (EN 83.0/75.3/54.3; ZH not reported). These are task benchmark scores, not a naturalness leaderboard rank or quality guarantee.
github_popularity_evidence: Hugging Face model API snapshot accessed 2026-10-10 reports 337,109 downloads and 433 likes for this exact checkpoint; these are popularity proxies only, not quality evidence. A current GitHub star count was not established from the inspected source snapshot and is not asserted.
integration_notes: Official repository provides the qwen-tts Python package and an explicit Qwen3TTSModel.from_pretrained(...).generate_voice_design(text=..., language=..., instruct=...) local Python integration, including batch examples and streaming support in its model overview. Repository says weights can be loaded via qwen-tts or vLLM, but the direct exact-variant voice-design API example is the qwen-tts Python wrapper. Official setup example is Python 3.12. Qwen's blog mentions access via Qwen API generally, but no exact remote API endpoint for this checkpoint was established. Local inference guidance is GPU-oriented; CPU-only viability remains unverified.
caveats: Report is scoped to one exact candidate and evidence available through 2026-10-10; no model/package was installed and no weights were downloaded.

No comparable public human/listening rank was found for the exact checkpoint. The cited InstructTTSEval results evaluate instruction adherence/attributes and must not be presented as a listener preference or naturalness ranking.
The 1.7B name and exact API parameter count differ: the model API reports 1,916,676,352 parameters.

Official documents reviewed provide a Python 3.12 setup and GPU/FlashAttention examples, but no CPU-only minimum RAM, CPU benchmark, or firm Linux support statement. Do not infer performance from the user's 8 cores/23 GiB RAM.
Weight byte total is the sum of the exact model and speech-tokenizer safetensors sizes in the official repository tree; additional software, cache, working memory and audio outputs are not included.
Voice cloning is only the separate Base model capability using reference audio; it is not text-only voice design.
